data.name: Life Sim
data.detailed_description:
Life Sim is a unique simulation game that gives you complete freedom to live however you choose. The game has no set goals—you define your own. Whether you want to build a successful career, manage properties, create a budget, stay fit, or anything else, Life Sim offers every essential feature you’d expect from a life simulation game.

In Life Sim, you are the center of everything. The world revolves around you. Shape your country’s economy for the better and raise the standard of living, or plunge it into chaos, leading to mass emigration and death waves. The choices are entirely yours.

You have the power to influence your country’s economy, agriculture, exports, and imports. Become the beloved king of your people, or play as the feared landowner who controls all the farmlands and is both hated and feared.

Life Sim lets you create your dream character and your dream country, putting ultimate control in your hands.

data.short_description: Life Sim is a text-based life simulation where your choices shape your destiny. Manage careers, control the economy, influence politics, and make decisions that affect the world around you. An immersive experience where every choice matters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (only 64 bit), Windows 8 (only 64 bit), Windows 10 (only 64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Pentium CPU G645T, 2,5+ GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 7800, AMD HD 4600, Intel HD3000 or similiar
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (only 64 bit), Windows 8 (only 64 bit), Windows 10 (only 64 bit)
  • Processor: Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 560 or higher, AMD Radeon HD 5800 or higher
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur) or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3 (Universal Binary, natively supports Apple Silicon and Intel Core series)
  • Memory: 7000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Integrated GPU or Intel Iris Plus / Radeon (OpenGL 3.3 compatible)
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard macOS compatible audio device

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, SteamOS 3.0 (Steam Deck), or Debian 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-Core Intel Core i3 @ 2.0 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 7000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or AMD Radeon Vega 8 (OpenGL 3.3 compatible, Mesa drivers recommended)
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA, PulseAudio, or PipeWire compatible sound system
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: no
